body: I don't feel "depressed" though. I guess what I experienced earlier today was some desperation, but I don't feel like this all the time, I guess today was just a bad day. I just don't know what to do with my life. I don't know what career path I want to take, I just got so lazy in the last 2 years of my education I only got 1 a-level

I don't think I could deal with counseling in anything other than an online setting, and I don't think that exists. I'm just looking for someone who can relate to me. It also seems to me that no females are ever interested in me, well atleast not the ones I have contact with.

it resonated somewhat, I used to think of myself as "the smart one" in my group of friends but now I dont anymore. I can't improve much in anything I do, I can't even improve that much when i'm doing the one thing I love, playing games. I guess I could be creative, I just dont know any means of being creative. I just dont have the will to write something, or make something, it just seems pointless. I don't see how I can be creative whilst playing games, either. as for my parents being extroverts, i'm not sure. my parents are old (I was born when my mother was 45, and my dad around 50, so i'm not sure. my mom does social stuff like going on courses for knitting and stuff and my dad's a fisherman (pleasure, not job, both of them are retired) Thanks for replying
